description: This file defines a Swift module for JPEG transcoding. It includes error handling via an enum, and a `JPEGTranscoder` struct with methods to re-encode JPEG images with size and quality constraints. The main function performs image decoding, property extraction, optional downscaling, and JPEG encoding, handling various error scenarios.

classes.name: JPEGTranscodeError
classes.description: Enum representing different error cases during JPEG transcoding, including decode failure, missing properties, encode failure, and size limit exceeded.

classes.name: JPEGTranscoder
classes.description: Struct providing static methods for JPEG transcoding, specifically converting image data to JPEG with optional resizing and quality adjustments.

methods.name: clampQuality
methods.description: Clamps a quality value between 0.05 and 1.0.

methods.name: transcodeToJPEG
methods.description: Main method to re-encode image data to JPEG, resizing image if needed to meet maximum width and/or size constraints, and adjusting quality accordingly. It handles image decoding, size calculation, optional downscaling, and encoding, throwing errors if operations fail or constraints cannot be met.
